summary: Large university car park, no homes within 37 m, shaded west bays.
reasons: Only university and research buildings around
Nearest dwelling 37 m, across a road

best_section.where: western bays of the big car park under the large tree, beside the university building

drivers.seclusion: Surrounded by university buildings, glasshouses and a solar-roofed car park; the nearest dwelling is the Sir Fred apartment block, 37 m away across a road.
drivers.access_and_room: Sealed lot with marked bays and several entrances; bays under the tree look free and fit a van.
drivers.traffic: Campus car park with daytime movement; quiet at night; road along the north edge.
drivers.convention: Lot full of parked vehicles; a van would not stand out.

flags: Signed Traffic Area restriction Mon-Fri 7am-6pm, Feb-Nov
Loading zone signs near the lot
Multi-level car park next door is mapped as paid
sun_shade: Large tree canopy shades the western bays, with shade from the west building in the afternoon.
rubbish: Some stacked items beside the sheds at the lot's east edge; none in the bays.
